advisory.summary: tor before 0.4.9.9 was prone to an infinite loop when decompressing a truncated zlib/gzip  stream...
advisory.description: tor before 0.4.9.9 was prone to an infinite loop when decompressing a truncated zlib/gzip  stream with done=1. A truncated stream never reaches Z_STREAM_END,  causing zlib to return Z_BUF_ERROR with no input remaining, which  buf_add_compress() mistook for a full output buffer and retried forever. Fixed by returning TOR_COMPRESS_ERROR in that case so the caller can abort cleanly. This is TROVE-2026-021.

cwes.name: Improper Validation of Specified Quantity in Input
